description: This file defines the `SettingsTab` SwiftUI view for configuring settings in an iOS OpenClaw application. It includes UI components for managing gateway connections, device features, and integrations with external services, with numerous bindings to stored preferences and models.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for the application's settings tab, managing gateway connections, device features, and preferences.

classes.name: FeatureHelp
classes.description: A simple identifiable struct for presenting help tooltips for features.

methods.name: gatewayList
methods.description: Displays a list of discovered gateways or last known gateway, with options to connect.

methods.name: featureToggle
methods.description: Creates a toggle switch with an info button for a specific feature.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Handles connecting to a discovered gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the last known gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates a string with debug information about gateway state and logs.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Builds the label for the 'connect last known' button, showing progress if connecting.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Synchronizes the manual port text input with current port value.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Processes the setup code input, applies configuration, and initiates connection.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and processes a setup code string into configuration parameters.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Extracts host and port info from a URL and updates manual gateway settings.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the effective manual port based on user input and settings.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Performs reachability checks to validate gateway connectivity before attempting connection.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to a given host and port asynchronously.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a manual gateway host and port.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state and clears associated settings and credentials.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Generates detailed information lines about a discovered gateway for display.
